blocks.text: sp³ hybridization mein ek s orbital (kam energy, gol/spherical) aur teen p orbitals (zyada energy, dumbbell shape) mil kar chaar naye orbitals banate hain jin ki energy aur shape ek jaisi hai. In mein se har ek sp³ hybrid orbital hai. Yeh hybrid orbitals tetrahedral geometry mein hote hain, jaise CH₄ mein (Fig. 3.27).
₆C ke valence shell ki configuration ground, excited aur hybridized haalat mein yeh hai:

blocks.alt: Carbon ke orbital dabbe teen qataron mein. 6C ground: 2s mein do ulte teer, 2px aur 2py mein ek ek oopar teer, 2pz khaali (Ground). C excited: 2s, 2px, 2py aur 2pz har ek mein ek oopar teer (Excited). C hybridized: chaar sp3 dabbe, har ek mein ek oopar teer (hybridized).
blocks.caption: Carbon ke electron dabbe: ground, excited aur sp3 hybridized haalat (kitab ke chhape box diagrams ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ground state mein carbon ke sirf do unpaired electrons hain, lekin carbon chaar bonds banata hai. Is liye ek 2s electron khali 2pz mein chala jata hai (excited state), aur phir yeh chaar orbitals mil kar chaar barabar sp³ orbitals bana dete hain, har ek mein ek electron.

Kitab ke mutabiq hybrid orbitals ki energy unhybridized orbitals se kam hoti hai. Figure 3.27 dikhati hai ke carbon ke bahar wale chaar atomic orbitals mil kar chaar barabar energy aur shape wale hybrid orbitals banate hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: 2s orbital (+ wala gola) jama 2px, 2py aur 2pz orbitals, har ek x, y, z mehwaron par dumb-bell, ek khaake wala lobe + ke saath. Neeche: 'Shape of one sp3 orbital having two lobes', ek chhota aur ek bara lobe, aur 'Four sp3 hybrid orbitals', tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf chaar lobes.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.27: Methane mein C ke sp3 hybrid orbitals ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.27 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Did you Know?
blocks.text: Har sp³ hybrid orbital ke do lobes hote hain, ek bara aur ek chhota. Aasani ke liye jab sab sp³ orbitals ek saath dikhaye jate hain to chhota lobe aam taur par nahi banaya jata.

Barabar energy wale chaar naye hybrid orbitals tetrahedral geometry mein hain aur carbon ka nucleus beech mein hai. Methane tab banta hai jab carbon ke chaar sp³ hybrid orbitals chaar hydrogen atoms ke 1s orbitals se alag alag overlap kar ke chaar sigma bonds banate hain. Yeh chaar C–H bonds (sp³-s overlap) regular tetrahedron ke corners ki taraf hain.
sp² hybridization mein ek atom ka ek s aur do p orbitals mil kar teen sp² hybrid orbitals banate hain. Teen aadhe bhare sp² orbitals trigonal planar (hamwar tikon) geometry mein 120° par hote hain.

blocks.alt: 2s orbital jama 2px orbital jama 2py orbital mehwaron par, 'Hybridization' likha teer, aur ek plane mein teen sp2 lobes, muRa dohra teer 120 degrees. Neeche daen: 'Shape of one sp2 orbital', + wala chhota lobe aur bara lobe.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.29: Atomic orbitals se sp2 hybrid orbitals ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.29 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: sp² hybridization BF₃ jaise planar molecules ki geometry samjhati hai. ₅B ki configuration yeh hai:

blocks.alt: Boron ke orbital dabbe teen qataron mein. 5B ground: 2s mein do ulte teer, 2px mein ek oopar teer, 2py aur 2pz khaali. B excited: 2s, 2px aur 2py mein ek ek oopar teer, 2pz khaali. B hybridized: teen sp2 dabbe, har ek mein ek oopar teer.
blocks.caption: Boron ke electron dabbe: ground, excited aur sp2 hybridized haalat (kitab ke chhape box diagrams ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: B ke bahar wale teen orbitals mil kar teen sp² hybrid orbitals banate hain. Doosri taraf fluorine ka ek p orbital aadha bhara hai (maslan 2pz). BF₃ tab banta hai jab boron ke teen aadhe bhare sp² orbitals teen fluorine atoms ke 2pz orbitals se overlap karte hain. Shape trigonal planar hai aur har bond angle 120° hai.

blocks.alt: (a) Boron atom ke teen bhoore sp2 lobes 120 degrees par, har ek fluorine atom ke neele 2pz orbital se overlap karta hai; sp2, F aur 2pz likha. (b) BF3 ki lakeeri tasveer: B teen F atoms se jura, F atoms ko milata dotted tikon, aur 120 degrees ka zawiya.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.30: sp2-p overlap se BF3 molecule ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.30 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: sp hybridization mein ek s orbital (kam energy, spherical) aur ek p orbital (zyada energy, dumbbell) mil kar do naye barabar energy aur shape wale orbitals banate hain jinhen sp hybrid orbitals kehte hain. Yeh do orbitals ek seedhi line mein, 180° par, hote hain. Be ke bahar wale shell ki configuration yeh hai:

blocks.alt: Beryllium ke orbital dabbe teen qataron mein. 4Be ground: 2s mein do ulte teer, teenon 2p dabbe khaali. Be excited: 2s aur 2px mein ek ek oopar teer, 2py aur 2pz khaali. Be hybridized: do sp dabbe, har ek mein ek oopar teer.
blocks.caption: Beryllium ke electron dabbe: ground, excited aur sp hybridized haalat (kitab ke chhape box diagrams ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Do sp hybrid orbitals ek seedhi line mein hain (Fig. 3.32). sp hybridization beryllium chloride (BeCl₂) jaise linear molecules ki geometry samjhati hai. BeCl₂ tab banta hai jab Be ke do sp orbitals do chlorine atoms ke aadhe bhare p orbitals se overlap karte hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: s orbital jama p orbital, 'Hybridization' likha teer, 'Two sp hybrid orbitals' ulti simton mein, aur 'sp hybrid orbitals shown together (Large lobes only)'. Neeche: Cl ke p orbitals Be ke do sp lobes se ek seedh mein overlap karte hain, 180 degrees, jo Cl-Be-Cl 180 degrees ke barabar hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.32: s aur p orbitals ka mil kar do sp hybrid orbitals dena aur BeCl2 ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.32 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: NH₃ aur CO₂ mein orbital hybridization aur har ek ki shape samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: NH₃: nitrogen ka 2s aur teen 2p mil kar chaar sp³ hybrids banate hain; teen mein ek ek electron hai jo hydrogen ke 1s se overlap karte hain, chauthe mein lone pair hai; shape trigonal pyramidal, angle 109.5° se thora kam (107°). CO₂: carbon ka 2s aur ek 2p mil kar 180° par do sp hybrids banate hain jo do oxygen atoms se σ bonds banate hain; baqi do p orbitals π bonds banate hain; molecule linear hai.

items: sp³: ek s + teen p, chaar hybrids, tetrahedral, 109.5° (CH₄, sp³-s overlap); har hybrid ka ek bara aur ek chhota lobe.
sp²: ek s + do p, teen hybrids, trigonal planar, 120° (BF₃, sp²-p overlap). sp: ek s + ek p, do hybrids, linear, 180° (BeCl₂, sp-p overlap).
